scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:frontend && youtrack-app app validate
scripts.build:nolint: npm run clean && npm run build:frontend && youtrack-app app validate
scripts.pack: rm -rf diffyt.zip && cd dist/ && npx --yes bestzip ../diffyt.zip *
scripts.upload-local: set -a && source .env && set +a && youtrack-app app upload --host $YOUTRACK_HOST --token $YOUTRACK_TOKEN
scripts.update: npm run build && npm run upload-local
scripts.watch: npm run clean && AUTOUPLOAD=true vite build --watch --mode development
scripts.dev:build: npm run clean && DEV_MODE=true vite build --mode development
scripts.dev:upload: npm run dev:build && npm run upload-local
scripts.dev: npm run dev:upload && npm run hmr
